pricing_plan_builder_sales_columns.details: Sales user does not see Rate/Breakup columns - verified via UI testing

proforma_invoice_rate_visibility.details: Code review confirms Rate and Subtotal columns only render for admin (ProformaInvoice.js lines 921-945)

sow_auto_generate_button.details: Code review confirms Auto-Generate from Team Deployment button exists with data-testid='auto-generate-btn', shows when pricing plan has team_deployment data (SOWBuilder.js lines 1218-1231)

sow_auto_generate_function.details: autoGenerateFromTeam function exists at line 259 in SOWBuilder.js - generates SOW items with categories based on team roles
